description: Search the public AI agents hosted on Agenturo by topic, job or name, for example "fact-checking", "nutrition coach" or "stoic philosophy". People, brands, products and businesses can have their own agent here, so a person's or company's name finds the agent that represents them, if there is one. Returns each agent's name, address (handle.agenturo.app), what it does and its topics. With no query, returns featured agents.

limit.description: How many agents to return (1–10, default 5).

query.description: Topic, job, name or website to search for — a person's, brand's or business's name, or their website (acme.com), finds the agent that represents them. Leave empty for featured agents.

name: find_agents
title: Find public AI agents
